resources.string: Shows up on your iPhone as \"%1$s\"
Ready — waiting for your iPhone or iPad
Could not start the AirPlay receiver (error %1$d). Check that the Fire TV is connected to Wi-Fi and reopen the app.

1. Connect your iPhone to the same Wi-Fi network as this Fire TV.
2. Swipe down from the top-right corner of the iPhone to open Control Center.
3. Tap Screen Mirroring (the two overlapping rectangles).
4. Pick this Fire TV from the list, then play your video full screen.

Keep this app open while you watch. Press Back or Home to stop.
